description.value: Subway North Nanaimotown Center is a franchise sandwich restaurant in north Nanaimo offering Footlongs, 6" sandwiches, wraps, salads, and breakfast with customizable fresh ingredients. The location supports in-restaurant dining, curbside pickup, and delivery. It sits in a strip-mall context on Rutherford Road, a main arterial corridor in the north end of Nanaimo.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 25m; rack at 59m; rack at 85m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Subway website confirms this is an active franchise location at 4750 Rutherford Road Unit 131, Nanaimo, BC with phone (250) 585-3334, both matching OSM data. The website explicitly states takeout, curbside pickup, delivery, and in-restaurant dining options, and OSM carries takeaway=yes. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are confirmed in the website content; the OSM internet_access=wlan tag cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration.
concerns: Website lists address as '4750 Rutherford Road Unit 131' while OSM omits the unit number — minor discrepancy, same physical location.
OSM internet_access=wlan not corroborated by website content; Wi-Fi left as null per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a standard national fast food chain with confirmed takeout but no cycling-specific amenities confirmed from evidence. It may serve as a convenient food stop on a busy north Nanaimo corridor, but the absence of any confirmed bike parking or cyclist-oriented facilities makes directory inclusion marginal and worth human review.
